title: The IRS Auditor Who Died With $22 Million
description:
Discover the incredible story of IRS auditor Anne Scheiber, who turned a modest $5,000 nest egg into a $22 million fortune through patience, dividend reinvesting, and extreme frugality. Learn the money rules school never taught you.
